description: This PHP class, PimCsvDataImport, handles the import of employee data from CSV files into the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It parses, validates, and saves employee attributes such as name, contact details, nationality, and employment information, ensuring data integrity and uniqueness as per system rules.

classes.name: PimCsvDataImport
classes.description: A class responsible for importing employee data from CSV files into the HRM system, including parsing, validation, and database persistence.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Main method to process an array of CSV row data, validate, and save a new Employee record.

methods.name: getDateTimeIfValid
methods.description: Converts a string date into a DateTime object if valid.

methods.description: Retrieves a Nationality entity based on the provided name if valid.

methods.name: getNationalityService
methods.description: Returns an instance of the NationalityService.

methods.name: getCountryCodeIfValid
methods.description: Returns a country code for a valid country name.

methods.description: Provides access to the CountryService via dependency injection container.

methods.name: getProvinceIfValid
methods.description: Returns a province code if the provided name is valid within the country context.
